title: India Economic Growth May Beat RBI’s 6.7% Forecast, Gupta Says
summary: India may grow closer to 7% in the financial year through March, stronger than the central bank’s 6.7% forecast, Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said on Thursday, a pace that would keep it among the world’s fastest-growing major economies.

title: PNJ’s Diamond Operations Cleared by Police in Wider Vietnam Gem-Smuggling Probe
summary: Phu Nhuan Jewelry JSC, known as PNJ, was cleared of wrongdoing in its diamond import and distribution operations according to the preliminary findings of a probe into cross-border smuggling that has shaken the nation’s gemstone sector. The stock surged.

title: BOC Aviation's Townend on Navigating Costs, Fuel, Growth

title: What Are Kangaroo Bonds? Why Alphabet Is Borrowing Billions in Australia
summary: Australia’s bond market is drawing increased interest from overseas borrowers. That includes Google’s parent Alphabet Inc., which issued debt in the country for the first time in August to help fund its AI spending. The technology giant raised A$5.5 billion ($3.9 billion) by selling so-called Kangaroo bonds.

title: Japan Lintec’s Stock Slides as Major Shareholder Sets Exit Plan

title: Pop Mart Drops After Warning 2026 Growth Target Out of Reach
summary: Pop Mart International Group Ltd. shares fell the most in nearly five months after the Labubu toymaker said it will likely miss its 2026 sales-growth target, citing a far tougher-than-expected first half.

title: India’s Mazumdar-Shaw Is On A Mission to Save Lives
summary:
Known as India’s ‘Queen of Biotech’, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw built Biocon from a rented garage almost 50 years ago. Today, her multibillion-dollar company is one of the world’s biggest producers of insulin, and a leading force in biosimilars. 
As she looks at handing over her life’s work to successors, Mazumdar-Shaw talks to Bloomberg’s Haslinda Amin about her pioneering journey as a female entrepreneur in India, her mission to deliver life-saving therapies to patients and what she believes India must do to tackle an AI future.  (Source: Bloomberg)
